plugins.name: team
plugins.description: Virtual-team operating model: a CTO/lead supervises on-demand specialists (builder/reviewer/researcher), runs bounded sequential sprints, and gates every change on top of an elevated adversarial reviewer. Project-agnostic — domain knowledge stays in per-project area skills.

plugins.name: paseo-cto
plugins.description: Dual Claude/Codex CTO plugin for an external Paseo agent fleet: owner-controlled model selection, isolated worktrees, bounded concurrency, machine-checkable task contracts, execution-verified review, finish notifications, safe integration, and a default 15-minute observation cadence.
